Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.error

Class ErrorPageViewResolver

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.error.ErrorPageViewResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.boot.webmvc.autoconfigure.error.ErrorViewResolver
@Component public class ErrorPageViewResolver extends Object implements org.springframework.boot.webmvc.autoconfigure.error.ErrorViewResolver
Chooses the error page Spring Boot's BasicErrorController renders for a browser: the error template with a generic text picked from the status only, and the branding. The model the controller offers (timestamp, path, exception, ...) is deliberately not passed on, so the page never shows a stack trace, an exception message, the requested path or anything else that could leak internals. Clients that do not accept HTML get the controller's JSON body, which spring.web.error.include-* keeps to the timestamp, the status and its reason phrase.
